detail: Full summary: My scorer regression test initially did NOT discriminate on the v2-path assertion — it passed unfixed because three unrelated regexes elsewhere in conflict-resolution.ts also match '.twining/records/decisions/'. Scoped the extraction to the coordinationFilePatterns array specifically. This is the third time in this review that a first-draft test failed to pin the behavior it named; always verify by stashing the fix.
